title: A task that adds a read-only command a skill calls carries its allow rules
goal: An item that adds a read-only command that skills or subagents run also adds its Bash and PowerShell allow rules to .claude/settings.json, the command refuses a path argument outside the repository with a test holding it, and /kb-backlog says so when it plans such a task
notes: Failure it answers (SP-mqjeanq3 retrospective): selfdoc.py section shipped and the skills call it, but .claude/settings.json got no allow rule, so every section read asks for permission (BG-as65f4wv, filed by the TK-22gyfp2h worker and left in the backlog). A second failure (SP-qdq57zu3 retrospective): the allow rule added for selfdoc.py section let it read files outside the clone without a prompt until the review found it (BG-kqtygmvv).
